contract: Account catalog: select and persist one of six local portraits. Match intro: show both portraits, names, tiers and Elo, then enter after 3.2 seconds or Enter now. Reuse SettingsStore, TierBadge and Dialog; support 375x812 and 1440x900 with reduced motion.

accessibility.evidence: Browser assertions verified tab arrows/Home, visible keyboard outlines, 44px-or-larger actions, labeled Radix dialog, Escape-to-enter, and animation:none under reduced motion. Text contrast reviewed on rendered overlay (now matched to the site’s warm palette). Screen-reader audio was not tested.

responsive.evidence: Verified zero horizontal overflow at 320/375/1440 widths in the catalog and exact fullscreen bounds at 375x812 and 1440x900 in the overlay. Long opponent names ellipsize and retain title text; portraits and ranks fit.

loading.evidence: Match entry progress is visible, with an Enter now action; automatic navigation is checked at 3.2 seconds.

empty.reason: This addition uses a fixed, nonempty local catalog; no empty remote result is loaded.

error.evidence: A mocked account PATCH failure keeps the prior selected icon and displays a retryable error; matchmaking errors show the existing lobby alert without opening the overlay.

partial.evidence: Guest packets have null ratings; both sides display Unranked and a fixed guest portrait with stable square bounds.

success.evidence: Account fixture saves persist after reload; match packets show supplied portraits, translated tiers and Elo; automatic entry, skip and reload-without-replay pass. Two browser tabs also entered the same friend room through a real isolated Socket.IO server, both saw the intro and both enabled game controls afterward.

permission.evidence: SQL integration verifies own-account RLS, allowed icon IDs and update grants; socket integration verifies account icons override client claims and guests retain their fixed icon.

renderedEvidence.observation: Mobile match overlay with long opponent nickname and reduced motion, square portraits and stacked ratings.
Desktop match overlay showing two character portraits, Platinum/Diamond badges, Elo and focused entry button.
Browser-only account fixture with six catalog portraits; selected dragon persists. SSR header is intentionally a guest because the fixture never reaches the server.
Real two-tab friend match on an isolated socket server with no database writer; both profiles are guest defaults.

limits: Authenticated browser data was fixture-backed; live authenticated multiplayer and production deployment were not tested.

contractDetails.surface: Account icon selection and match-found overlay
contractDetails.job: Pick a predefined portrait, then recognize both players before entering a match.
contractDetails.primaryAction: Equip a portrait; match entry happens automatically or with Enter now.
contractDetails.hierarchy: Match found → portraits and names → tiers and Elo → entry progress.
contractDetails.references: Existing loadout SettingsStore, ProfileIcon assets, TierBadge, and Radix Dialog components.
contractDetails.constraints: Korean/English, same-origin SVGs, server-authoritative ratings, no private IDs in lobby messages, keyboard support and reduced motion.

validation.lint: Changed web files and browser tests passed
validation.database: profile_icons migration applied and icon_id column verified
